# agyn_workspace_configuration (Resource)

Manages an Agyn workspace configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_workspace_configuration" "example" {
  title          = "My Workspace"
  description    = "An example workspace configuration managed by Terraform."
  image          = "ghcr.io/agynio/workspace:latest"
  platform       = "auto"
  enable_dind    = false
  ttl_seconds    = 600
  cpu_limit      = "2"
  memory_limit   = "4Gi"
  initial_script = "echo 'workspace ready'"

  env {
    name  = "APP_ENV"
    value = "production"
  }

  volumes {
    enabled    = true
    mount_path = "/workspace"
  }

  nix = jsonencode({
    packages = ["git", "curl"]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `config` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated JSON-encoded workspace configuration. Use structured attributes instead. Cannot be used together with the structured configuration attributes. Use one approach or the other.
- `cpu_limit` (String) CPU limit for the workspace (string or number as a string).
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the workspace configuration.
- `enable_dind` (Boolean) Whether to enable Docker-in-Docker.
- `env` (Attributes List) Environment variables for the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env))
- `image` (String) Container image for the workspace.
- `initial_script` (String) Initial script to run in the workspace.
- `memory_limit` (String) Memory limit for the workspace (string or number as a string).
- `nix` (String) Nix configuration as JSON.
- `platform` (String) Platform selection. Must be one of `auto`, `linux/amd64`, or `linux/arm64`.
- `title` (String) Human-readable title of the workspace configuration.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Time-to-live in seconds for the workspace.
- `volumes` (Attributes) Workspace volume configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the workspace configuration.

<a id="nestedatt--env"></a>
### Nested Schema for `env`

Exactly one of `value` or `value_ref` must be specified.

Required:

- `name` (String) Environment variable name.

Optional:

- `value` (String) Literal environment variable value.
- `value_ref` (Attributes) Reference to a vault or variable-backed value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env--value_ref))

<a id="nestedatt--env--value_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `env.value_ref`

Required:

- `key` (String) Key within the referenced secret.
- `kind` (String) Reference kind (vault or variable).
- `mount` (String) Mount name for the referenced secret store.
- `path` (String) Secret path within the referenced store.



<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether volumes are enabled.
- `mount_path` (String) Mount path for the volume.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import agyn_workspace_configuration.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
